scripts.format:check:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run --project apps/api mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/app apps/api/scripts
scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:check: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini check
scripts.check:web: pnpm format:check:web && pnpm lint:web && pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm test:web && pnpm build:web
scripts.check:api: uv lock --check && pnpm format:check:api && pnpm lint:api && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm test:api
scripts.check: pnpm format:check:docs && pnpm check:api && pnpm check:contract && pnpm check:web
